speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing episodic cough and shortness of breath; to better understand your condition, how long have these symptoms been occurring?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pertussis (Whooping Cough).

The 8-week history following an upper respiratory infection, combined with episodic nonproductive cough and shortness of breath in an older adult, is highly suggestive of pertussis. I am requesting a Pertussis PCR test to confirm the diagnosis.
